manuscript_D_statement: The full new-input campaign has 60/60 sealed independently paid observations. In K, S2/P qualified certificate counts are 6/2 across 12 repeated comparisons on 6 problems; strict directions are {'Win': 6, 'UNDETERMINED': 6}. In X, S2/P qualified certificate counts are 11/7 across 12 repeated comparisons on 6 problems; strict directions are {'Win': 10, 'Lose': 1, 'UNEVALUABLE': 1}. These are finite within-mechanism and geography-transfer observations; same-problem Seeds are repeats, and both-open times remain censored. PS attribution is confined to its prospectively selected six-problem subset. Problem-level zero/positive/unknown status is distinguished from each arm's attained endpoint; a zero observation at35 stations does not establish positive-objective35 proof performance. There are 1 disclosed source-reduced own-zero observations: their legal own physical zero proofs and raw production clocks remain, but frozen performance eligibility excludes them, formal T_cert is null and affected comparisons are UNEVALUABLE. They are neither ordinary open results nor time Wins; the rejected native sources are not rehabilitated.
manuscript_C_statement: The cost panel has 24/24 sealed same-build workflows. S2R-GEOM / S2R gives {'Win': 2, 'Lose': 4, 'UNDETERMINED': 2} across 8 repeated comparisons. S2R-SP / S2R gives {'Win': 3, 'Lose': 3, 'UNDETERMINED': 2} across 8 repeated comparisons. Any native-process or cost change is not an ideal relaxation-strength increase; unexposed root/node fields remain unknown.
